notes: Parts are from the UHF 438-470 MHz board 8486348Z13-C. Parts marked '*' (U201, U401, U402, U404 and Y201) are Motorola depot servicing only.

gaps: The other part numbers on those boards were not checked against this record.
It gives FCC designations ABZ99FT4056, ABZ99FT4057 and ABZ99FT4058 for CP200 UHF without saying which band each covers, so no FCC ID is set.
method: Board parts come from the Motorola CP150/CP200 Commercial Series detailed service manual 6880309N62-C (June 2005, 252 pages; Internet Archive copy), which is shared with the CP150.

Page references: radio parts list on pages 12-49 to 12-52 (PDF pages 231-234); speaker and microphone list on page 12-3 (PDF p.185); transmitter power on page 9-3 (PDF p.153); audio amplifier description on page 3-5 (PDF p.25).

The same manual has an earlier 438-470 MHz board (8486348Z09-A, PA module listed as 5102466J01, RA07M4452M), a 465-495 MHz board listing the same 0186438Z02 RA07M4452M module, a 403-440 MHz board with RA07M4047M, and VHF boards with other modules (RA07M1317M on two of them).
The RA07M4452M datasheet describes it as a 440-520 MHz, 7 W, 7.2 V two-stage module.
Battery, charger and antenna come from the Motorola CP200 specification sheet (Version 2 12/09, (c) 2010.

PDF hosted by dealer PSI), which says all CP200 models include a Li-Ion 2250 mAh battery, a rapid rate charger and an antenna (VHF Heliflex or UHF whip), lists 1600 mAh slim Li-ion, 1400 mAh NiMH and 950 mAh NiCd packs, and gives the radio's power supply as 7.5 V +/-20%.
FCC exhibits were not reachable (bot checks / access denied).

comps.spec: UHF 438-470 MHz transmitter, switchable high 4 W / low 1 W per channel, or factory preset 2 W, depending on model
U110 transmitter PA module Mitsubishi RA07M4452M (Motorola 0186438Z02)
Silicon NPN transistors Q21 BFS505, Q51 PBR941, Q100 BFG540W, Q280 BFS540; also MMBT3904 NPN (Q70, Q150) and MMBT3906 PNP (Q403)
U404 flash ROM 128K x 8 AT49LV001N (listed as AT49LV001N_70VI); U402 serial EEPROM 16K x 8 X25128-2.7
U490 audio power amplifier TDA8541 (Motorola 5108858K99), bridge amp giving 500 mW into the internal 24 ohm speaker
Y201 crystal 16.8 MHz (4880114R06); Y51 crystal 44.395 MHz (4802245J84); Y70 455 kHz ceramic discriminator
U310 5 V regulator TK71750S, U330 3 V regulator TK71730S, U320 adjustable regulator with reset LP2986
S444 rotary on-off switch with 10K volume control (1880619Z02)
J140 external antenna connector (0986428Z01) with antenna nut M140; J471 2.5/3.5 mm accessory connector (0980683Z03); J301 battery contact assembly (0986565Z01)
SP1 speaker assembly with connector, Motorola 5005679X04 (24 ohm internal speaker per the audio section)
Li-ion 2250 mAh battery included with all CP200 models (1600 mAh slim Li-ion also listed)
1400 mAh NiMH battery listed in the spec sheet's size, weight and battery-life tables
Rapid rate charger included with all CP200 models
UHF whip antenna included (VHF models get a Heliflex antenna)
